title: Smart School Hub
overview: The Smart School Hub provides administrative, teaching, and learning management capabilities while maintaining strict reliability, usability, and maintainability standards. The system is built with a decoupled frontend and backend architecture supported by an extensible database model.

tech_stack.name: React
tech_stack.evidence_quote: The separation of frontend (React) from the backend (Django)

tech_stack.name: Django
tech_stack.evidence_quote: The separation of frontend (React) from the backend (Django)

tech_stack.name: SQLite
tech_stack.evidence_quote: The underlying SQLite database schema must be de- signed with forward compatibility in mind.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Administrative user of the system who receives alerts on critical runtime issues.
roles.evidence_quote: Given the user base (Admin, Teacher, and Student)

roles.name: Teacher
roles.description: Teaching user who performs high-frequency tasks such as marking attendance and submitting grades.
roles.evidence_quote: Given the user base (Admin, Teacher, and Student)

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Student user who accesses grades and dashboard features.
roles.evidence_quote: Given the user base (Admin, Teacher, and Student)

requirements.title: Availability
requirements.text: The system shall maintain an availability of 99% during core school operating hours (7:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays).
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall maintain an availability of 99% during core school operating hours (7:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays).

requirements.title: Data Integrity
requirements.text: The system must prevent data corruption during simultaneous write operations by utilizing database transaction locks (ACID properties).
requirements.evidence_quote: The system must prevent data corruption during simultaneous write operations (e.g., two teachers submitting attendance at the exact same moment) by utilizing database transaction locks

requirements.title: Error Logging
requirements.text: The system shall log all runtime errors internally.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall log all runtime errors internally

requirements.title: Error Messages
requirements.text: The system shall provide user-friendly error messages that guide the user back to a valid state without losing input data.
requirements.evidence_quote: provide user- friendly error messages that guide the user back to a valid state without losing input data.

requirements.title: Administrator Alerts
requirements.text: Critical issues shall raise immediate alerts for the administrator.
requirements.evidence_quote: Critical issues shall raise immediate alerts for the administrator.

requirements.title: Interface Design Consistency
requirements.text: All three user interfaces (Admin, Teacher, Student) shall adhere to a single, unified design standard (color scheme, navigation bar placement, and button styles) to reduce cognitive load across roles.
requirements.evidence_quote: All three user interfaces (Admin, Teacher, Student) shall adhere to a single, unified design standard (color scheme, navigation bar placement, and button styles) to reduce cognitive load across roles.

requirements.title: Task Efficiency
requirements.text: Users shall be able to complete high-frequency tasks (e.g., a Teacher marking attendance, a Student checking grades) with a maximum of five clicks from their respective dashboard.
requirements.evidence_quote: Users shall be able to complete high-frequency tasks (e.g., a Teacher marking attendance, a Student checking grades) with a maximum of five clicks from their respective dashboard.

requirements.title: Feedback and Confirmation
requirements.text: Every critical action (e.g., successful submission of grades, password change) must result in immediate, visual confirmation or an error message, reducing user uncertainty.
requirements.evidence_quote: Every critical action (e.g., successful submission of grades, password change) must result in immediate, visual confirmation or an error message, reducing user uncertainty.

requirements.title: Extensible Data Model
requirements.text: The primary tables (Students, Teachers) must allow for the addition of new columns or relationships with minimal disruption.
requirements.evidence_quote: The primary tables (Students, Teachers) must allow for the addition of new columns or relationships (e.g., adding a parent id foreign key) with minimal disruption
